builds.name: Tormented Shadow: five-second missing-health burn
builds.summary: Investigate high one complete Tormented Shadow exposure output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one complete Tormented Shadow exposure output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: W deals 18/31/44/57/70 + 0.2 AP magic per second for five seconds and increases with target missing health up to twice that rate. Rank-5 baseline full contact is 350 + 1.0 AP, while an all-capped rate would be 700 + 2.0 AP only if the live health multiplier actually allowed it for every tick.
